_note: Layout of the stacked h3r / n7 mark, measured from the shipped h3nr7-mark-black.svg (itself built from the Illustrator master). Units are em of the font size; origin = the baseline origin of the 'h'; y points DOWN. bbox_em is each glyph's outline box in its own y-up font space, so scripts/build_mark.py can check it was given the right glyph and weight. See SKILL.md.

font.note: Not bundled: only the regular Italic ships with h3nr7-design and its outlines are narrower, so it does not reproduce the mark.
